name: Silver Street, Western End
desc1: Crowds of people mill about the street here, and you are forced to
desc2: push through to make your way. You smell a delicious scent wafting
desc3: through the door of the tall wooden building to the south. A boldly-
desc4: lettered sign hanging over the door reads "The Homely Hearth". To the
desc5: north, an ornate door stands wide open, and "Sentara's Clothing" is
desc6: written on it in a flowing silvery script. To the west, you can see
desc7: the bustle of the town square, and Silver street goes off to the east.
